$comment: R42 C1: ran H7xF4/H8xF4 keytext cells under panel-R36 (T-LEG -> TRIED). 23 real texts swept, 0 crossers (best 5.479 vs bar 17.42). Data-integrity finding: 10 of 33 keytexts are globalgrey 404 HTML, excluded + listed. New row + patch the inconclusive verification row.

new_rows.control_detail: Standing free-null bar of record (bars_v3 'free', the measured 12-register null; plant-recover calibration from R34/R37 I1). Data-integrity gate: 10 of 33 files classified as fetch-error HTML and excluded before scoring, so the negative is over intact texts only.
new_rows.hypothesis: One of the R35 esoteric keytexts ('the key is all around you' / 'right in front of your eyes', H7xF4/H8xF4) is the LP2 running key.
new_rows.result: NEGATIVE. 23 intact texts (of 33; 10 are globalgrey 'Page Not Found' HTML, excluded) swept as running keys over 55 unsolved pages, ~150 stride-sampled start offsets x 2 signs x 2 atbash, adjudicated under panel-R36. Global best pmax 5.479 (boehme_aurora.txt, page 26, L=265, start 100800, sign-1 atb1, reg LP1_REAL) vs free bar of record 17.42 at N~13,800; 0 crossers, no near-miss. Upgrades H7xF4/H8xF4 from T-LEG (legacy) to TRIED (panel-R36).
new_rows.coverage: 23 of 33 keytexts (intact), running-key Vigenere + atbash, ~150 offsets/text, both signs, over all 55 unsolved pages; panel-max over 12 registers.
new_rows.threshold: bars_v3.bar_v3(N~13800, L in {120,240,400} nearest-and-conservative, 'free'); crosses iff non-degenerate grid-max >= bar.

three_conditionals.key_space: the 23 intact R35 esoteric keytexts as running keys (offset-swept)
three_conditionals.transition_model: running-key Vigenere c +/- key, non-repeating, start offset swept, both signs, atbash
three_conditionals.adjudicator_register: panel-R36, panel-max over 12 registers; free-null bar of record

new_rows.not_covered: The 10 corrupt 404 captures (achad_qbl, alghazali_alchemy_happiness, dee_hieroglyphic_monad, emerald_tablet_hermetic, iamblichus_mysteries, meister_eckhart_pfeiffer, porphyry_life_plotinus, sepher_yetzirah_westcott, theologia_germanica, waite_holy_kabbalah) - need a fresh hash-pinned re-download; running-key offsets beyond the ~150 stride-sample per text; texts outside this corpus; a fresh per-shuffle null.
new_rows.reopens_if: the 10 corrupt texts are re-fetched (hash-pinned) and swept; the oracle flags a page; a finer offset sweep is run.
new_rows.notes: Data-integrity finding: 10 of the 33 R35 keytexts are stale globalgrey 404 HTML pages, not the esoteric books. The intact 23 are a measured negative under panel-R36.
